testimonials.text: The most interesting aspects were the clear explanation of different anaesthetic techniques for caesarean delivery and the practical, step-by-step approach. The clinical scenarios and visual materials helped to better understand decision-making in everyday practice, especially in resource-limited settings.

I found the sections on cognitive aids during crisis situations and their practical application in the operating room most interesting, as well as the parts covering anaesthesia management for caesarean delivery and how to handle emergencies effectively.
Content was applicable to work. Enjoyed the question on caesarean category as classifications can be tricky.

The practical aspects of obstetric anaesthesia, particularly spinal anaesthesia for caesarean delivery, management of spinal-induced hypotension, and airway considerations during emergency caesarean sections.
Rapid sequence spinal was new to me and was interesting.

The discussion on post-dural puncture headache was particularly insightful, especially regarding the recommendation to prioritize phenylephrine over ephedrine in clinical practice. Overall, the entire content was highly informative and demonstrated significant relevance to my professional practice in the field of anesthesia.
